{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABbYKtxQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhE8nYU", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 182, "title": "Move Graph Editor model requirements and terms into Help", "body": "## Problem

The expandable **“Model requirements and terms”** notice currently sits immediately below **Save graph** in Graph Editor. It consumes prominent editing space even though it is reference information rather than a primary graph-editing control.

## Expected outcome

Move the existing **“Model requirements and terms”** content into the **existing Graph Editor Help dialog**, presented as a collapsed/expandable section.

- Remove the standalone notice from the main Graph Editor layout beneath the toolbar/Save graph.
- Keep the same context-dependent model preparation notices for Nodes in the current draft graph, including relevant resource requirements and terms.
- Preserve access to existing legal/attribution links and the Models page for preparation and recovery. Do not remove or weaken required model notices.
- Do not add a new top-level button, separate screen, or extra Settings control; use the existing **Help** entry point.
- Do not modify Save graph behavior, which models are prepared, model download/cache logic, or graph/session state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The area below Save graph no longer shows a separate “Model requirements and terms” disclosure.
- [ ] Opening **Help** reveals an easily discoverable, initially collapsed “Model requirements and terms” section that can be expanded to see notices for the currently drafted Nodes.
- [ ] The section stays accurate after adding/removing Nodes and after loading/resetting drafts, including when there are no applicable notices.
- [ ] Existing Models and license/terms links remain reachable and keyboard accessible.
- [ ] Focus, keyboard interaction, narrow layouts, and Help open/close behavior work without regression.
- [ ] Relevant Graph Editor tests and concise documentation are updated; graph persistence and model preparation remain unchanged.
